question: How does facility delivery coverage compare across districts in 2022 and 2023?

view.title: Facility Delivery Coverage by District (2022–2023)
view.note: Each bar shows the percentage of recorded deliveries that occurred in a health facility for a given district and year. Use the year selector to compare districts within a single year. Values are illustrative and are not official statistics.

interpretation_guard.caveat: The source supplies percentages only; it does not supply counts or causal explanations. Differences between districts or years cannot be attributed to specific causes from this data alone.
